statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to assess the efficacy of current management strategies
The denial reason is that coverage may be available through another insurer pursuant to coordination of benefits protocols
The service was rejected because the insurer is the secondary payer
